fusions.name: Disarming Twist
fusions.desc: Catches the target's weapon arm and twists, which deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second, leaves it [Damped] for 6 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Count to Five
fusions.desc: Throws 5 fingertip jabs at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Plucked from the Air
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is caught and dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Close-Fitting Glove
fusions.desc: Conjures a fitted glove: you attack 5% faster, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
